stories.title: Price of diesel in UK hits all-time high, new figures show

en.title: Price of diesel in UK hits all-time high, new figures show
en.summary: UK diesel prices have reached a record level, surpassing the previous peak recorded in 2022 after Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

stories.title: Three dead, including child, in Channel crossing attempt

en.title: Three dead, including child, in Channel crossing attempt
en.summary: A boat carrying 105 people across the English Channel resulted in three deaths: a 10-year-old child and two women in their 30s.

stories.title: UK diesel price hits all-time high, RAC says

en.title: UK diesel price hits all-time high, RAC says
en.summary: UK diesel prices have reached record levels due to tensions involving the US, Israel, and Iran, which have driven fuel costs upward.

stories.title: Three migrants, including a child, die trying to cross English Channel

en.title: Three migrants, including a child, die trying to cross English Channel
en.summary: Three people, including a child, died during an attempted English Channel crossing on an inflatable boat carrying 105 migrants.

stories.title: What is the triple lock pension? Everything you need to know as PM told to scrap pledge

en.title: What is the triple lock pension? Everything you need to know as PM told to scrap pledge
en.summary: The triple lock pension system adjusts state pensions based on inflation, wage growth, and other factors. The Prime Minister has been urged to abandon this commitment.

stories.title: Streeting says farmer who ‘foiled bomb plot’ at RAF Fairford only has ‘partial picture’

en.title: Streeting says farmer who 'foiled bomb plot' at RAF Fairford only has 'partial picture'
en.summary: Police are investigating a potential Iranian connection to an incident near a Gloucestershire RAF base that hosts US bombers. A farmer involved in the incident may lack full information about what occurred.

stories.title: Who is replacing Sara Cox as host of Radio 2’s Drivetime?

en.title: Who is replacing Sara Cox as host of Radio 2's Drivetime?
en.summary: Sara Cox is departing from her role hosting Radio 2's Drivetime program. The outlet reports on who will take over the position.

stories.title: Avanti West Coast services to be nationalised from March

en.title: Avanti West Coast services to be nationalised from March
en.summary: Avanti West Coast rail services will be brought under public ownership beginning in March. The transition aims to enhance rail infrastructure, reduce delays, and improve passenger services.

stories.title: UK security forces were aware of RAF Fairford suspected bomb plot, hints defence secretary

en.title: UK security forces were aware of RAF Fairford suspected bomb plot, hints defence secretary
en.summary: The UK defence secretary indicated that security services had advance knowledge of a group arrested on terrorism charges after explosives were found in vans near RAF Fairford, a US military base. He suggested a farmer who reported the plot to police had incomplete information.

stories.title: Angela Scanlon takes over Sara Cox's drivetime slot on Radio 2

en.title: Angela Scanlon takes over Sara Cox's drivetime slot on Radio 2
en.summary: Angela Scanlon has been appointed as the new presenter for Radio 2's drivetime slot, replacing Sara Cox. The station also announced a new presenter for its country music programme following Bob Harris's departure.

stories.title: Why the PM could finally drop the triple lock pension pledge

en.title: Why the PM could finally drop the triple lock pension pledge
en.summary: Andy Burnham stated he would make difficult budgetary decisions to establish a new national care service, raising the possibility that the government may reconsider its commitment to the pension triple lock.

stories.title: Avanti West Coast to be renationalised in March

en.title: Avanti West Coast to be renationalised in March
en.summary: Avanti West Coast, the rail operator serving London, Birmingham, the north-west and Glasgow, will return to public ownership on 7 March after its contract ends. The operator has experienced the highest cancellation rates across the UK rail network.

stories.title: Bond sell-off deepens as oil rises above $108

en.title: Bond sell-off deepens as oil rises above $108
en.summary: Ten-year Treasury yields reached 5.2% while Brent crude climbed above $108 per barrel, as prospects for a US-Iran agreement diminished.

stories.title: ‘Xi got face’: China relishes equal treatment from Trump

en.title: 'Xi got face': China relishes equal treatment from Trump
en.summary: Chinese state media praised the respectful manner in which the US president treated China's leader during their interactions.

en.title: US and China agree $60bn low tariff regime for goods from foie gras to camels
en.summary: The US and China established a $60 billion arrangement with reduced tariffs on non-sensitive goods as efforts to reduce bilateral tensions.

stories.title: EU countries consider Nato-style joint responses to Russian hybrid attacks

en.title: EU countries consider Nato-style joint responses to Russian hybrid attacks
en.summary: European Union nations are exploring coordinated military-alliance-style responses to Russian hybrid operations including drone strikes, bombings, and arson incidents conducted throughout the year.

stories.title: GM warns on US market as carmakers seek ‘safe haven’ from Chinese rivals

en.title: GM warns on US market as carmakers seek 'safe haven' from Chinese rivals
en.summary: General Motors is reducing costs and shifting focus toward affordable electric vehicles as international competitors, particularly from China, increase their presence in the American market.
